about: Answer key for the generated trial documents. 'seeded' lists issues planted on purpose; 'layer' says which rule layer should catch each one: base (OSS-guide rules, already in the checker), overlay (strict-plain rules from chunks 1.2 to 1.6) or none (no planned rule; only a human or the agent's judgement catches it). 'facts' must survive any edit. Snippets are exact substrings of the document. Version 2: items that only the dropped phrasal-verb and noun-cluster rules would catch are labelled 'none'.

facts: Upgrading from 1.x directly to 3.0 is not supported; upgrade to 2.9 first.
Requirements: 64-bit Windows 10+, macOS 13+, or Linux with glibc 2.31+; 200 MB for the program and 2 GB for the cache; port 443.
Admin rights are needed only to install the background service.
After the first sync with 3.0 you cannot downgrade.
Do not uninstall 2.x first: uninstalling deletes the stored access keys.
Migration may take several minutes for folders with more than 100,000 files.

The uninstaller does not remove ~/.demosync/cache and never touches files in synced folders or the bucket.

facts: All endpoints are under /api/v2 and return JSON.
Missing or invalid token gives 401; read-only token on a write endpoint gives 403.
600 requests per minute per token; 429 with Retry-After; clients that ignore it may be blocked for up to 15 minutes.
limit is 1 to 200, default 50.
source and target are required; without schedule the job runs once.
delete_extraneous defaults to false; true deletes target files missing from the source and cannot be undone.
A duplicate source and target returns 409 Conflict with the existing job's ID; success returns 201 Created.
Cancelling does not roll back transferred files; purge=true deletes history permanently.
Webhooks must respond 2xx within 10 seconds; up to 6 retries with exponential backoff from 30 seconds; then the webhook is disabled and admins are emailed.
Deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256; verify X-DemoSync-Signature before trusting the payload.
Revoke the old token within 24 hours; unused tokens expire after 90 days and cannot be renewed.

facts: Symlink loops slow scanning; demosync doctor --symlinks reports them.
If scanning takes more than 10 minutes, scan_mode = "mtime" compares only modification times, so a file changed without a timestamp update is not synced.
Error 403 means the key lacks write permission; the fix needs write and list permissions, then demosync auth refresh.
Locked objects cannot be overwritten until retention ends (1 day to 10 years).
Deletes are not synced by default; push --delete removes remote files, which cannot be undone unless bucket versioning is on.
Hashing uses at most 2 CPU cores by default; hash_threads = 1 lowers it but scans are slower.
Logs are in ~/.demosync/logs (macOS, Linux) and %LOCALAPPDATA%\DemoSync\logs (Windows).
Debug logs contain file paths and bucket names; do not share them publicly.
Support usually responds within 2 business days.
The bucket can throttle uploads; to stop a stuck sync, stop the demosync process.
